text_zh: 第三排那个别碰，D-0223用过后手抖了一周
text_en: 3rd shelf - don't touch, D-0223's hands shook for a week

text_zh: 铅币不够的话可以用铅屑，老板不会算
text_en: Short on coins? Use shavings, shopkeep can't count

text_zh: 左边那排效果都一样，买便宜的就行
text_en: Left row all same effect, just buy the cheap one

text_zh: 又涨价了...上周才15铅币的
text_en: Price hike again... was 15 coins last week

text_zh: 谁把我的笔拿走了？第三次了！
text_en: Who took my pen AGAIN? 3rd time!

text_zh: 这里的东西越来越少，补货的人去哪了
text_en: Less stock each day, where's the resupply crew?

text_zh: D-0117说那个能让字变金色，试了没用
text_en: D-0117 said it turns words gold. Didn't work.

text_zh: D-0089在这买了什么后就升级了，不肯说
text_en: D-0089 got promoted after buying here. Won't tell.

text_zh: 昨天看到有人在角落哭，今天就不见了
text_en: Saw someone crying in corner yesterday. Gone today.

text_zh: 老板从来不眨眼，你们注意到了吗？
text_en: Shopkeep never blinks. Anyone else notice?
